items.headline: FDA approves first oral drug for drug-resistant herpes in immunocompromised patients
items.summary: The FDA approved pritelivir, sold as Hovilpri, as the first oral treatment for herpes sores in immunocompromised adults who don't respond to standard antiviral pills. In its phase three trial, lesions fully healed within four weeks for about sixty three percent of patients on the new drug, compared with thirty four percent on existing treatment.
items.why_it_matters: Patients with weakened immune systems who develop drug-resistant herpes lesions often needed intravenous treatment, so an effective oral option is a meaningful improvement in care.
